<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"

  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Player" name="Player and farming bot" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SendMaterials" name="Send materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Begin bot setup"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set resource urgency"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfigureDependencies" name="Configure resource and tool dependencies"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Farming"/>
      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_FarmOneResource" name="Farm one selected resource">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OneResource"/>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GatherResource" name="Gather resource using configured urgency and dependencies"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OneResource"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneResource_Start_Gather" sourceRef="StartEvent_OneResource" targetRef="Task_GatherResource"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneResource_Gather_End" sourceRef="Task_GatherResource" targetRef="EndEvent_OneResource"/>
        <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
          <bpmn:loopCardinality>min(numberOfSelectedResources, 10)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
        </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Farming"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_Start_Resources" sourceRef="StartEvent_Farming" targetRef="SubProcess_FarmOneResource"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_Resources_End" sourceRef="SubProcess_FarmOneResource" targetRef="EndEvent_Farming"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_NaturalDisaster" name="Handle natural disaster" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_NaturalDisaster" signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply farming setback"/>

        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Start_Setback" sourceRef="StartEvent_NaturalDisaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify on milestone" triggeredByEvent="true">

          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Milestone">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">A farming milestone is reached</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>

        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Notify_End" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update farming list" triggeredByEvent="true">

            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Player requests a farming-list update</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ListUpdated"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Start_Task" sourceRef="StartEvent_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Task_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_ListUpdated"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostFarmSplit" name="Choose post-farming actions" default="Flow_PostFarm_None"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostFarmJoin" name="Complete post-farming actions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Farming and selected actions complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Select" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Urgency" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Urgency_Dependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_Farming" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_PostSplit" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostFarm_Brag" name="Brag selected" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">bragSelected = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostFarm_Send" name="Send materials selected" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">sendMaterialsSelected = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostFarm_None" name="No post-farming action selected" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Player and farming bot" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Begin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetUrgency</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostFarmSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostFarmJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Begin bot setup"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Choose resources to farm"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set resource urgency"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfigureDependencies" name="Configure resource and tool dependencies"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Farming">
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot_Work" name="Farming bot">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_NaturalDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingPlayer" name="Player">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
      </bpmn:laneSet>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Farming" name="Begin farming"/>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm resources by urgency and configured dependencies, collecting up to 10 in parallel"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Farming" name="Farming finished"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_Start_Farm" sourceRef="StartEvent_Farming" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_Farm_End" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="EndEvent_Farming"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_NaturalDisaster" name="Handle natural disaster" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_NaturalDisaster">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_NaturalDisaster" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_NaturalDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NaturalDisasterHandled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_NaturalDisaster">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A random natural disaster strikes during farming</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply setback to farming bot"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NaturalDisasterHandled" name="Setback applied"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Start_Setback" sourceRef="StartEvent_NaturalDisaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Setback_End" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="EndEvent_NaturalDisasterHandled"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify on milestone" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Milestone">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Milestone" name="Farming bot">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MilestoneNotified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Milestone" name="Farming milestone reached" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Milestone">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A farming milestone is reached</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified" name="Player notified"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Start_Notify" sourceRef="StartEvent_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Notify_End" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update farming list" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_UpdateList">
          <bpmn:lane id="Lane_UpdateList" name="Player">
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
            <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ListUpdated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          </bpmn:lane>
        </bpmn:laneSet>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_UpdateList" name="Player requests farming-list update" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_UpdateList">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Player requests a farming-list update while farming</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to be farmed"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ListUpdated" name="Farming list updated"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Start_Task" sourceRef="StartEvent_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Task_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_ListUpdated"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostFarmSplit" name="Choose post-farming actions" default="Flow_PostFarm_None"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostFarmJoin" name="Complete selected post-farming actions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Farming and selected actions complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Select" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Urgency" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Urgency_Dependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_Farming" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_PostSplit" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostFarm_Brag" name="Brag selected" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Bragging is selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostFarm_Send" name="Send materials selected" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Sending materials is selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostFarm_None" name="No post-farming action selected" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarmJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
